title: Patch Notes — July 28, 2026
highlights: Upgrade VFX added for +8, +9, and +10 equipment
NPC and Goblin death animations added without ragdoll for better FPS
Tutorial steps added for targeting and spell casting
Scrap Metal tutorial quest requirement reduced from 5 to 3
Chicken Pet bonus granted after Tutorial Chapter 1 Part 3 with an equip tutorial step
Aurora Wave mana cost per projectile increased by 1.5x
Race Reroll odds normalized to 33.33% per race
Item drops no longer use physics
Damage Contest UI now requires that the player dealt damage and the monster is within render distance
Upgrade cosmetic effect setting changed to a Show/Hide toggle
Premium Shop, Purchase History, Redeemed Codes, Mail, Play Time, Daily Login, Liked Players, Social Likes, and Settings made account-bound
Dewdrop optimized with roughly 4 million triangles removed

title: Patch Notes — July 30, 2026
highlights: Chapter 2 released
Items now display Bound, Tradeable, or Free status
Aurora Wave reworked: no channeling, charge-up behavior, more bolts, higher damage, explosion around target
Blade Circuit gained more slashes and more damage
Timber Charge damage increased, hit behavior fixed, and it stuns non-demihumans for 1 second
Bosses and mini-bosses can no longer be knocked around
Bash stun and slow duration increased
Heal now scales with Magic Attack
Mana Shield blocks crowd control except Cripple
Long-range attacks against targets far above or below now miss
Junk King HP increased from 35,000 to 1,050,000
Tin Tortoise HP increased from 37,500 to 525,000
Junk King and Tin Tortoise accessory drops made about 25% more common and spirit stones about 2.5x more common
Spirit stone effects can trigger every 1 second instead of every 3 seconds
Build Mode placement grid added
World loot unlocks after completing Working the Land
Quest NPCs can no longer be attacked
Anti-cheat began pulling back speed, jump, and fly exploits

title: Patch Notes — August 3, 2026
highlights: Stuck monsters return to spawn after 2 seconds and are invulnerable while returning
New Enchanter skill Aqua Bloom added as Water-element magic
Premium Pass added
New Door decoration recipe added
Monsters gained elemental attributes
Headgear added to the Codex
Build Mode overlay added with invalid placements shown in red
Fortune Clover, Bone Bite, Tinker's Goggles, and Plague Mask headgear added

title: Patch Notes — August 5, 2026
highlights: Greenhouse became craftable at the Workbench
Maximum 1 Greenhouse per plot by default
Season 1 Premium Pass grants +1 additional permanent Greenhouse slot
Level 20 players received 1 Ultimate Skillbook as compensation
Goblin Claw Machine Ultimate Skillbook changed from Untradeable to Tradeable
Fish and Food assets were reworked
Boss Quest removed from Battle Pass Quest and EXP moved to Mini Boss Quest
Battle Pass +1 Level option (+3000 EXP) added for 15 Robux
Party/Solo Top 1-3 Damage tracking fixed for quests and Codex
Swimming-stuck issue fixed
Second-door usability issue fixed

title: Patch Notes — v1.1.6
highlights: Lycaros added as a Weekly World Boss
HP/MP regeneration formula changed to Base Regen + Bonus Regen
Bonus Regen equals 0.2% of Max HP/MP and is capped at 3% of Max HP/MP
Regeneration multipliers: 50% in combat, 100% out of combat, 150% while sitting
Body Slam added for Defender
Tailwind added for Enchanter
Blade Rush added for Warrior
Doombell added for Cleric
Whirlwind changed to scale with DEF instead of PATK and scaling increased from 100% to 400%
Aqua Bloom damage formula fixed and rebalanced
Dewdrop Ore Nodes increased from 20 to 35
Identify system added for Shoes, Gloves, Bracelet, Necklace, and Upper/Middle/Lower Headgear
Magnifying Glasses used for Identify are dropped by Lycaros

title: Update & Patch Notes v1.1.8
highlights: Lycaros Prize Pool UI fixes
Forge UI fixes
Player interaction now only triggers while sheathed
Timber Charge grants CC immunity during use; deferred CC applies afterward
Timber Charge vs Timber Charge remains an exception
Additional Quick Slots unlock after clearing Chapter 2
Skill VFX Filter settings added: Self, Party, Everyone
World Motion graphics toggle added
